title: Ford press releases Jan-Apr 1966 - 12130682
doc_notes: This document is a collection of press releases from Congressman Gerald R. Ford, which includes his correspondence and public statements regarding UFO sightings and his calls for a congressional investigation.

encounters.summary: A UPI report from Ann Arbor, Michigan, stated that at least 40 persons, including 12 policemen, claimed to have seen a strange flying object guarded by four sister ships land in a swamp.
